question: With which of the following states is the traditional instrument called 'Pena' associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Pena' is associated with **Manipur**__.
 
• It is also the oldest musical instrument of the Meitei group of people.
 
• It is played in folk music, solo, in a group, or as the accompanying instrument for the Manipuri dance and at the Lai Haraoba festivals.
 
• It belongs to the category of chordophones and is a bowed mono-string instrument.
 
• The main body is called 'Penamasa' and is made out of bamboo and the bow is called 'Pena Cheijing. '
 
• It is attached to a coconut shell, which is the resonator and is cut in half.
